{{Top|leg}}
The '''Korbin Equatorial Range''' was a large swath of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] that ringed the entire equator of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]]. The peaks of the mountains were covered in ice and snow, with howling winds. Only two safe passes through the mountains were known to exist; [[Selenfer]], which linked the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Pleasant City]] and [[Happy]], and [[Refin]], with connected [[Joy (city)|Joy]] and [[Peace]].
